Data:Potatoes.json.Label: Potatoes
Data:Potatoes.json.Desc: [Slice 'em with a Knife and add dripping to make Game Chips; or roast 'em with or without dripping.]

Data:Potatoes.roast.json.Label: Roast Potatoes
Data:Potatoes.roast.json.Desc: You really need rosemary for roast potatoes, but fortunately, the kitchen garden at Hush House has never been short of rosemary.

Data:Potatoes.roast.magnificent.json.Label: Magnificent Roast Potatoes
Data:Potatoes.roast.magnificent.json.Desc: It's the dripping that elevates it. Roast potatoes are a feast for the senses, but the dripping deepens the flavour profile, makes the experience continue through the machinery of the mouth to become a kind of journey.

Data:Pottery.scrumpy.h.json.Label: Scrumpy (Half-Finished)
Data:Pottery.scrumpy.h.json.Desc: The West Country's most unregenerate achievement; perhaps at its best when pressed from stolen apples.

xexts.scrutiny: That buttonholing back-of-the-throat tang-grab unique to the very roughest of apples.

Data:Poundnote.json.label: One Pound Note
Data:Poundnote.json.desc: A noble paper in soothing green. Britannia lounges on her throne, flaming hammer propped insouciantly across her knee.

Data:Precursor.mem.dreamt.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: A Stolen Secret

Data:Precursor.mem.fear.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Fear
Data:Precursor.mem.fear.json.desc: 'The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear, and the oldest and strongest kind of fear is fear of the unknown.' - Lovecraft

Data:Precursor.mem.foresight.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Foresight
Data:Precursor.mem.foresight.json.desc: 'Wit's forge and fire-blast, meaning's press and screw.' - Coleridge, 'On Donne's Poetry'

Data:Precursor.mem.hindsight.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Hindsight
Data:Precursor.mem.hindsight.json.desc: Some things we can only really understand when they're gone.

Data:Precursor.mem.impulse.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Impulse
Data:Precursor.mem.impulse.json.desc: It doesn't exactly make sense - but I understand it anyway.

Data:Precursor.mem.loss.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Loss
Data:Precursor.mem.loss.json.desc: Whatever it was, now it isn't.

Data:Precursor.mem.revelation.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Revelation
Data:Precursor.mem.revelation.json.desc: Some truths come to us from outside, or above.

Data:Precursor.mem.satisfaction.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Satisfaction
Data:Precursor.mem.satisfaction.json.desc: Some appetites are easier to satisfy than others.

Data:Precursor.mem.sight.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Sight
Data:Precursor.mem.sight.json.desc: 'The eye sees more than the heart knows.' - Blake

Data:Precursor.mem.sound.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Sound
Data:Precursor.mem.sound.json.desc: A memory lasts longer than an echo. Of course when Speech came into the world, and we could cast echoes into words, things got more complicated.

Data:Precursor.mem.storm.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Storm
Data:Precursor.mem.storm.json.desc: There are storms great enough to shake the moon from the sky, and one's thoughts from one's skull.

Data:Precursor.mem.touch.json.Label: Acquiring a Memory: Touch
Data:Precursor.mem.touch.json.desc: Craft is learnt through the tips of the fingers.
